- **Signal:** the z token moves along the insulin quiet direction by 0.131 per unit of decoded deviation (correlation 0.91 with the true deviation), with noise sd only 0.005 at non-drug bundles. The NE direction moves 0.117 per unit NE rate.

- insulin ×2 moves well past −2 toward −12.5, with ×½ positive and roughly half the size;
- NE ×2 moves toward +4.3.

Wrong signs, or a huge asymmetric response, would mean the injected direction or scale is wrong.
